title: Made a build from iOS for Mac Catalyst arm64 and x86_64
body:
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Build TensorFlowLiteC.xcframework with slices for:
#   - iOS device (arm64)
#   - iOS simulator (arm64 + x86_64)
#   - Mac Catalyst (arm64 + x86_64)
# targeting a minimum deployment target of iOS 15.0.
#
# Requirements (run on macOS):
#   - Xcode + command line tools
#   - CMake >= 3.16
#   - Ninja (brew install ninja) -- optional but faster
#   - git
#
# This uses TFLite's official CMake build (tensorflow/lite/CMakeLists.txt)
# plus the community "ios-cmake" toolchain, since Google's own bazel-based
# ios/build_ios_framework.sh does NOT support Mac Catalyst.

set -euo pipefail

# CMake >= 4.0 removed compatibility with the very old cmake_minimum_required()
# lines still present in several of TFLite's pinned third-party deps (FP16,
# possibly cpuinfo/pthreadpool/ruy too). Passing -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM
# on our own configure call only covers subprojects pulled in via
# FetchContent -- deps pulled in via ExternalProject_Add (like FP16) spawn
# their own separate `cmake` process that does NOT inherit our -D flags.
# The environment variable form below *does* get inherited by every child
# process, so export it globally before any cmake invocation.
export CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5

# ---- Config -----------------------------------------------------------
TF_TAG="${TF_TAG:-v2.16.1}"          # TensorFlow release tag to build
DEPLOYMENT_TARGET="15.0"             # shared min iOS / Catalyst target
ROOT_DIR="$(pwd)/tflitec_build_work"
TF_SRC="${ROOT_DIR}/tensorflow"
IOS_CMAKE="${ROOT_DIR}/ios-cmake"
OUT_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/out"
LIBNAME="tensorflowlite_c"           # CMake target name for the C API
HEADER_SRC="${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/c"  # public C headers to embed

mkdir -p "${ROOT_DIR}" "${OUT_DIR}"

# ---- 1. Fetch sources --------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -d "${TF_SRC}" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${TF_TAG}" https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow.git "${TF_SRC}"
fi

# ---- 1a. Patch known TF-source / newer-Xcode incompatibilities ---------
# TF ${TF_TAG}'s kernels/elementwise.cc takes the address of std::abs<float>
# and std::abs<int32_t> directly to pass as a std::function<T(T)>. Newer
# libc++ (shipped with recent Xcode/SDKs) makes that address-of ambiguous,
# producing "no matching function for call to 'EvalImpl'". Wrapping in an
# explicit lambda sidesteps the ambiguity without changing behavior.
patch_tflite_sources () {
  echo "=== Patching TFLite sources for newer Xcode/libc++ compatibility ==="
  local ew="${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc"
  if [ ! -f "${ew}" ]; then
    echo "  (elementwise.cc not found at expected path -- skipping patch)"
    return
  fi
  if grep -q 'std::abs<float>, type' "${ew}"; then
    sed -i '' 's/std::abs<float>, type/[](float x) { return std::abs(x); }, type/' "${ew}"
    echo "  patched std::abs<float> call"
  fi
  if grep -q 'std::abs<int32_t>, type' "${ew}"; then
    sed -i '' 's/std::abs<int32_t>, type/[](int32_t x) { return std::abs(x); }, type/' "${ew}"
    echo "  patched std::abs<int32_t> call"
  fi
}
patch_tflite_sources

if [ ! -d "${IOS_CMAKE}" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/leetal/ios-cmake.git "${IOS_CMAKE}"
fi

TOOLCHAIN="${IOS_CMAKE}/ios.toolchain.cmake"

# ---- 1b. Build a HOST flatc ---------------------------------------------
# flatc is a code-generator that must run on the build machine, not the
# target (iOS/Catalyst) arch. TFLite's CMake will otherwise try to cross-
# compile flatc itself and then fails trying to "install" it as an iOS
# bundle executable (the error you hit). We build one host flatc, matching
# the exact flatbuffers version TFLite pins, and hand it to every slice.

FB_MODULE="${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/tools/cmake/modules/flatbuffers.cmake"
if [ ! -f "${FB_MODULE}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: expected file not found: ${FB_MODULE}" >&2
  echo "  (tensorflow clone/checkout may have failed or moved this file)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ -n "${FB_TAG_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then
  FB_TAG="${FB_TAG_OVERRIDE}"
else
  FB_TAG="$(grep -oE 'GIT_TAG[[:space:]]+[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' "${FB_MODULE}" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' || true)"
fi

if [ -z "${FB_TAG}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not auto-detect the flatbuffers GIT_TAG from:" >&2
  echo "  ${FB_MODULE}" >&2
  echo "--- full file contents below, for manual inspection ---" >&2
  cat "${FB_MODULE}" >&2
  echo "--- end file contents ---" >&2
  echo "Set FB_TAG_OVERRIDE=<tag> and re-run, or paste the file contents above so the script can be fixed." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "=== Building host flatc (flatbuffers ${FB_TAG}) ==="

FB_SRC="${ROOT_DIR}/flatbuffers-host"
if [ ! -d "${FB_SRC}" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${FB_TAG}" https://github.com/google/flatbuffers.git "${FB_SRC}"
fi

FB_HOST_BUILD="${ROOT_DIR}/build-flatc-host"
cmake -S "${FB_SRC}" -B "${FB_HOST_BUILD}" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 \
  -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATC=ON \
  -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
  -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATLIB=OFF \
  -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATHASH=OFF
cmake --build "${FB_HOST_BUILD}" --target flatc -- -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)"

HOST_FLATC="${FB_HOST_BUILD}/flatc"
[ -x "${HOST_FLATC}" ] || { echo "host flatc not found at ${HOST_FLATC}"; exit 1; }
echo "=== Host flatc ready: ${HOST_FLATC} ==="

# ---- 2. Helper: configure + build one platform slice -------------------
# args: <label> <ios-cmake PLATFORM value> <build subdir>
build_slice () {
  local label="$1"
  local platform="$2"
  local build_dir="${ROOT_DIR}/build-${label}"

  echo "=== Building ${label} (PLATFORM=${platform}) ==="
  rm -rf "${build_dir}"
  mkdir -p "${build_dir}"

  cmake -S "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/c" \
    -B "${build_dir}" \
    -G Ninja \
    -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="${TOOLCHAIN}" \
    -DPLATFORM="${platform}" \
    -DDEPLOYMENT_TARGET="${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}" \
    -DENABLE_BITCODE=OFF \
    -DENABLE_ARC=ON \
    -DENABLE_VISIBILITY=OFF \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 \
    -DTFLITE_ENABLE_XNNPACK=ON \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DTFLITE_C_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DFLATBUFFERS_BUILD_FLATC=OFF \
    -DFLATBUFFERS_FLATC_EXECUTABLE="${HOST_FLATC}"

  cmake --build "${build_dir}" --target "${LIBNAME}" -- -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)"
}

# ---- 3. Build each slice ------------------------------------------------
# ios-cmake PLATFORM values used here:
#   OS64                -> iOS device, arm64
#   SIMULATORARM64      -> iOS simulator, arm64 (Apple Silicon host)
#   SIMULATOR64         -> iOS simulator, x86_64 (Intel host)
#   MAC_CATALYST_ARM64   -> Mac Catalyst, arm64
#   MAC_CATALYST         -> Mac Catalyst, x86_64

build_slice "ios-device"        "OS64"
build_slice "ios-sim-arm64"     "SIMULATORARM64"
build_slice "ios-sim-x86_64"    "SIMULATOR64"
build_slice "catalyst-arm64"    "MAC_CATALYST_ARM64"
build_slice "catalyst-x86_64"   "MAC_CATALYST"

find_lib () {
  find "${ROOT_DIR}/build-$1" -name "lib${LIBNAME}.a" | head -1
}

# ---- 4. Fat-merge simulator and catalyst arch pairs ---------------------
mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}/libs"

lipo -create \
  "$(find_lib ios-sim-arm64)" \
  "$(find_lib ios-sim-x86_64)" \
  -output "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-iossim.a"

lipo -create \
  "$(find_lib catalyst-arm64)" \
  "$(find_lib catalyst-x86_64)" \
  -output "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-catalyst.a"

cp "$(find_lib ios-device)" "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-iosdevice.a"

# ---- 5. Wrap each slice as a minimal .framework --------------------------
# xcodebuild -create-xcframework wants real .framework bundles (or plain
# .a + headers, which it also accepts). We use plain static libs + a
# headers dir per platform, which is the simplest reliable path.

HEADERS_OUT="${OUT_DIR}/Headers"
rm -rf "${HEADERS_OUT}"
mkdir -p "${HEADERS_OUT}"
cp "${HEADER_SRC}"/*.h "${HEADERS_OUT}/"
# also grab the common.h / builtin_op_data.h etc. some C API headers pull in
find "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.h" -exec cp {} "${HEADERS_OUT}/" \;

# ---- 6. Create the XCFramework --------------------------------------------
XCFRAMEWORK_OUT="${OUT_DIR}/TensorFlowLiteC.xcframework"
rm -rf "${XCFRAMEWORK_OUT}"

xcodebuild -create-xcframework \
  -library "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-iosdevice.a" -headers "${HEADERS_OUT}" \
  -library "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-iossim.a"    -headers "${HEADERS_OUT}" \
  -library "${OUT_DIR}/libs/lib${LIBNAME}-catalyst.a"  -headers "${HEADERS_OUT}" \
  -output "${XCFRAMEWORK_OUT}"

echo "=== Verifying static (archive) libraries, not dylibs ==="
for f in "${OUT_DIR}/libs/"*.a; do
  file "${f}"
done

# ---- 7. Verify / repair per-slice Headers folders -------------------------
# xcodebuild -create-xcframework has a known rough edge when building from
# raw .a + -headers pairs (as opposed to full .framework bundles): the
# Headers/ folder and/or the Info.plist "HeadersPath" key can end up
# missing for some platform-variant slices -- Mac Catalyst is the slice
# most commonly affected. Force every slice to have populated headers and
# a correct Info.plist entry regardless of what xcodebuild did.
echo "=== Verifying headers are present in every xcframework slice ==="
PLIST="${XCFRAMEWORK_OUT}/Info.plist"
SLICE_COUNT="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :AvailableLibraries" "${PLIST}" | grep -c 'LibraryIdentifier =')"

for i in $(seq 0 $((SLICE_COUNT - 1))); do
  LIB_ID="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :AvailableLibraries:${i}:LibraryIdentifier" "${PLIST}")"
  SLICE_DIR="${XCFRAMEWORK_OUT}/${LIB_ID}"
  SLICE_HEADERS="${SLICE_DIR}/Headers"

  if [ ! -d "${SLICE_HEADERS}" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A "${SLICE_HEADERS}" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "  ${LIB_ID}: Headers missing/empty -- copying in"
    mkdir -p "${SLICE_HEADERS}"
    cp "${HEADERS_OUT}"/*.h "${SLICE_HEADERS}/"
  else
    echo "  ${LIB_ID}: Headers OK ($(ls "${SLICE_HEADERS}" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files)"
  fi

  HAS_HEADERS_PATH="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :AvailableLibraries:${i}:HeadersPath" "${PLIST}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -z "${HAS_HEADERS_PATH}" ]; then
    echo "  ${LIB_ID}: Info.plist missing HeadersPath -- adding it"
    /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :AvailableLibraries:${i}:HeadersPath string Headers" "${PLIST}"
  else
    echo "  ${LIB_ID}: Info.plist HeadersPath OK (${HAS_HEADERS_PATH})"
  fi
done

echo "=== Done: ${XCFRAMEWORK_OUT} (static XCFramework) ==="

```

Also write pod spec run both these in .xcodeproj directory of your app

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Assembles two local CocoaPods pods from a prior build_tflitec_xcframework.sh run:
#   LocalPods/TensorFlowLiteC     -- vendors the built TensorFlowLiteC.xcframework
#   LocalPods/TensorFlowLiteObjC  -- the real ObjC wrapper source, copied from the
#                                    tensorflow checkout, compiled against the above
#
# Run this from the same directory you ran build_tflitec_xcframework.sh from
# (it expects ./tflitec_build_work to exist), or override via env vars below.

set -euo pipefail

# ---- Config (override via env if your paths differ) --------------------
ROOT_DIR="${ROOT_DIR:-$(pwd)/tflitec_build_work}"
TF_SRC="${TF_SRC:-${ROOT_DIR}/tensorflow}"
XCFRAMEWORK_SRC="${XCFRAMEWORK_SRC:-${ROOT_DIR}/out/TensorFlowLiteC.xcframework}"
TF_TAG="${TF_TAG:-v2.16.1}"
VERSION="${VERSION:-${TF_TAG#v}}"          # strip leading 'v' -> 2.16.1
DEPLOYMENT_TARGET="${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET:-15.0}"
PODS_DIR="${PODS_DIR:-$(pwd)/LocalPods}"

C_POD_DIR="${PODS_DIR}/TensorFlowLiteC"
OBJC_POD_DIR="${PODS_DIR}/TensorFlowLiteObjC"

# ---- Sanity checks -------------------------------------------------------
[ -d "${XCFRAMEWORK_SRC}" ] || { echo "ERROR: xcframework not found at ${XCFRAMEWORK_SRC}"; exit 1; }
[ -d "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/apis" ]    || { echo "ERROR: ${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/apis not found"; exit 1; }
[ -d "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/sources" ] || { echo "ERROR: ${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/sources not found"; exit 1; }

# ---- 1. TensorFlowLiteC local pod ----------------------------------------
echo "=== Assembling TensorFlowLiteC pod ==="
rm -rf "${C_POD_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${C_POD_DIR}/Frameworks"
cp -R "${XCFRAMEWORK_SRC}" "${C_POD_DIR}/Frameworks/"

cat > "${C_POD_DIR}/TensorFlowLiteC.podspec" <<EOF
Pod::Spec.new do |s|
  s.name              = 'TensorFlowLiteC'
  s.version            = '${VERSION}'
  s.authors            = 'Google Inc.'
  s.license            = { :type => 'Apache' }
  s.homepage           = 'https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow'
  # Unused when consumed via :path in the Podfile -- CocoaPods reads the
  # local directory contents directly and never fetches this.
  s.source              = { :git => 'file:///dev/null' }
  s.summary             = 'TensorFlow Lite C library (locally built)'
  s.description         = <<-DESC
Locally built TensorFlow Lite C library, vendored as an XCFramework covering
iOS device, iOS simulator, and Mac Catalyst, targeting a minimum of iOS ${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}.
This pod is not intended to be used directly -- depend on TensorFlowLiteObjC
(or TensorFlowLiteSwift) instead.
  DESC
  s.cocoapods_version   = '>= 1.9.0'
  s.ios.deployment_target = '${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}'
  s.module_name         = 'TensorFlowLiteC'
  s.library             = 'c++'

  s.pod_target_xcconfig = {
    'EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]' => 'i386'
  }
  s.user_target_xcconfig = {
    'EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]' => 'i386'
  }

  s.default_subspec = 'Core'
  s.subspec 'Core' do |core|
    core.vendored_frameworks = 'Frameworks/TensorFlowLiteC.xcframework'
  end
end
EOF

echo "  -> ${C_POD_DIR}"

# ---- 2. TensorFlowLiteObjC local pod --------------------------------------
echo "=== Assembling TensorFlowLiteObjC pod ==="
rm -rf "${OBJC_POD_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${OBJC_POD_DIR}/tensorflow/lite/objc"
cp -R "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/apis"    "${OBJC_POD_DIR}/tensorflow/lite/objc/"
cp -R "${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/sources" "${OBJC_POD_DIR}/tensorflow/lite/objc/"

PRIVACY_SRC="${TF_SRC}/tensorflow/lite/objc/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy"
PRIVACY_DST="${OBJC_POD_DIR}/tensorflow/lite/objc/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy"
if [ -f "${PRIVACY_SRC}" ]; then
  cp "${PRIVACY_SRC}" "${PRIVACY_DST}"
else
  echo "  (no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in this TF checkout -- generating a minimal stub)"
  cat > "${PRIVACY_DST}" <<'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>NSPrivacyTracking</key>
	<false/>
	<key>NSPrivacyTrackingDomains</key>
	<array/>
	<key>NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes</key>
	<array/>
	<key>NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes</key>
	<array/>
</dict>
</plist>
PLIST
fi

cat > "${OBJC_POD_DIR}/TensorFlowLiteObjC.podspec" <<EOF
Pod::Spec.new do |s|
  s.name                = 'TensorFlowLiteObjC'
  s.version              = '${VERSION}'
  s.authors              = 'Google Inc.'
  s.license              = { :type => 'Apache' }
  s.homepage             = 'https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow'
  s.source                = { :git => 'file:///dev/null' }
  s.summary               = 'TensorFlow Lite for Objective-C (locally built)'
  s.description           = <<-DESC
Objective-C wrapper around a locally built TensorFlow Lite core, covering
iOS device, iOS simulator, and Mac Catalyst, targeting a minimum of iOS ${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}.
  DESC
  s.cocoapods_version     = '>= 1.9.0'
  s.ios.deployment_target = '${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}'
  s.module_name           = 'TFLTensorFlowLite'
  s.static_framework      = true

  s.pod_target_xcconfig = {
    'HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS' => '"\${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}" "\${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/tensorflow/lite/objc/apis"',
    'EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]' => 'i386'
  }
  s.user_target_xcconfig = {
    'EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]' => 'i386'
  }

  s.default_subspec = 'Core'

  s.subspec 'Privacy' do |privacy|
    privacy.resource_bundles = {
      'TFLTensorFlowLite' => 'tensorflow/lite/objc/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy'
    }
  end

  s.subspec 'Core' do |core|
    core.public_header_files = 'tensorflow/lite/objc/apis/*.h'
    core.source_files        = 'tensorflow/lite/objc/{apis,sources}/*.{h,m,mm}'
    # Excluded because this build doesn't vendor the CoreML/Metal delegate
    # xcframeworks -- these wrapper files call symbols that plain
    # tensorflowlite_c (built via tensorflow/lite/c/CMakeLists.txt) doesn't
    # export. Remove this line only if you separately build+vendor those.
    core.exclude_files       = 'tensorflow/lite/objc/{apis,sources}/TFL{Metal,CoreML}Delegate.{h,m}'
    core.dependency 'TensorFlowLiteC', '${VERSION}'
    core.dependency 'TensorFlowLiteObjC/Privacy', '${VERSION}'
  end
end
EOF

echo "  -> ${OBJC_POD_DIR}"

# ---- 3. Podfile snippet ----------------------------------------------------
cat <<EOF

=== Done. Add this to your app's Podfile: ===

platform :ios, '${DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}'

target 'YourAppTarget' do
  pod 'TensorFlowLiteC',    :path => 'LocalPods/TensorFlowLiteC'
  pod 'TensorFlowLiteObjC', :path => 'LocalPods/TensorFlowLiteObjC'
end

Then, from your app project root (with LocalPods/ alongside the Podfile):
  pod install

For Mac Catalyst: the xcframework slice is already in there, but Catalyst
support also has to be turned on at the *app target* level in Xcode
(General -> Supported Destinations -> Mac Catalyst, or the
SUPPORTS_MACCATALYST = YES build setting) -- the podspec can't set that
for you, it only makes the binary available once enabled.
EOF

```
